llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are internally consistent with a local persistent-memory integration for OpenClaw, but you should verify the grantai-mcp binary/image and be cautious about importing sensitive files or secrets into the memory store.

dimensions.detail: The skill advertises persistent local memory for agents and declares a single required binary (grantai-mcp). The configuration examples (direct command or Docker run) and listed tools (infer, teach, learn, capture, etc.) align with that purpose. Nothing requested appears unrelated to a memory provider.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to call grantai-mcp (or a Docker image) and to import local directories and capture conversation turns verbatim. Those instructions are within the claimed memory feature, but they permit broad file imports and verbatim capture of conversations — meaning the agent could index any local file or sensitive conversation if asked. The doc does not explain how keys are managed or what network operations grantai-mcp performs.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No registry install spec was provided (this is instruction-only), but SKILL.md points to solonai.com for downloads and to a GitHub Container Registry image (ghcr.io/solonai-com/grantai-memory:1.8.6). Those are plausible and standard distribution channels. Because there is no packaged install in the registry metadata, you must manually fetch/install the binary or run the container — verify sources and prefer pinned image digests or official installers.

dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables, no credentials, and no config-path requirements. That matches the documentation which claims local operation and AES-256 at rest. There is no disproportionate credential request.

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not request special agent-wide privileges in the metadata. It will persist data by design (memory store), which is expected for this capability. Autonomous invocation is allowed by default but not a unique concern here.

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for adding persistent local memory, but you should verify the code you run and limit what you import: 1) Obtain grantai-mcp or the Docker image only from the official SolonAI sources and preferably pin to a specific release digest. 2) If possible, run the binary/container in a sandbox or test environment first and monitor its network activity to confirm 'data never leaves your machine.' 3) Understand where the memory is stored (e.g., grantai-data volume) and who controls the encryption keys — the SKILL.md claims AES-256 but does not say how keys are derived or protected. 4) Avoid using grantai_learn / grantai_capture on directories that contain secrets, credentials, or personally identifiable information until you confirm storage and key management. 5) Prefer the Docker option if you cannot audit the binary locally, and review the image digest on GHCR. If you want higher assurance, request a signed release or reproducible build information from the vendor before installing.
